email_draft.subject: Escalation: Critical Exceptions in Invoice Processing for INVO001
email_draft.body:
Dear AP Manager,

During the processing of invoice INVO001 (PO1001) from vendor FreshFarm Veg Suppliers, the following critical exceptions were identified:

- LLM_SCREENING_UNAVAILABLE: GROK screening failed: Extra data: line 1 column 5596 (char 5595)
- GST_MISMATCH: GST number in invoice (27AABCF1234K1Z2) does not match PO master (27AABCF1234K122)
- TOTAL_AMOUNT_MISMATCH: Invoice total (13450.0) does not match calculated sum from items (12440.0) or PO total (12440.0)

Additional issues:
- ITEM_NAME_VARIATION: Minor variation in item names (e.g., 'Onions' vs 'Onion') - Severity: info
- GRN_QTY_VARIATION: GRN quantities slightly exceed PO quantities for some items (e.g., Onion: GRN 101 > PO 100) - Severity: warning

Overall, 3-way matching failed due to total amount and GST discrepancies, though item-level details match within tolerances. Screening raised critical issues, but matching was evaluated on available context.

Please review the attached details and provide guidance on resolution.

Best regards,
AP Operations Bot
